label: Correspondence Codex · Connected atlas
title: Follow a correspondence into its system, its values, and the Classic catalog
summary: Codex cards and their values now open the relevant source system or entry. Color and chakra swatches, restrained geometric vectors, and a separate Classic-only discovery path make the atlas easier to read and explore.
details: Each system card opens the actual filtered Codex system. Values open matching source rows, using the source annotation to resolve qualified entries such as Ares [Greek]; where no standalone row exists, the link highlights that value in its original row rather than inventing an entry.
Colors and chakras gain curated presentation swatches, while geometry and Platonic-solid values gain small labelled SVG cues. Text remains readable and accessible.

The earlier Classic engine remains intact. A lazily loaded, searchable Classic-only section now reveals 205 names absent from the 824 matrix source-row labels under a normalized-name comparison. These profiles are explicitly kept distinct from CSV source rows.
verification: Feature revision b34b095 was Ready on both canonical VOA domains at 2026-09-25 10:23 UTC. Live browser checks followed a Colors card and Red value to their target, opened Fire Agate in Classic, and verified the no-standalone-row focus and annotated deity link. Local suite 59/59, TypeScript and production build passed. At 10:32 UTC, 136/136 distinct checked live URLs returned HTTP 200 (133 sitemap entries plus three extra URLs). This is not a measured Oracle speedup claim.

label: Correspondence Codex v2 · Oracle
title: A new correspondence atlas, and an Oracle that begins speaking sooner
summary: Correspondence Codex v2 is live alongside the classic engine. The Oracle now reveals text as it arrives, and tradition cards gain lightweight responsive artwork.
details: Codex v2 maps all 824 rows of the supplied 27-system supermatrix into searchable, filterable entries with provenance, related paths, deep links, and side-by-side comparison. It is a navigable study atlas, not an independently verified canon for every correspondence.
Its compact index loads first; individual entry details load only when opened. The previous correspondence engine remains available under Classic.
Oracle answers now stream into the conversation without a shorter answer limit. A completed answer is still retained for saving and playback; total generation time varies by question and provider.
Eight tradition cards reveal existing small artwork on hover and keyboard focus, while touch and reduced-motion visitors receive a static treatment.
This Updates page is now part of site navigation. The Dreamwalker Remote Viewing menu's Basic protocol prompt completed a full browser answer without the former unsupported-mode error.
Authenticated member journeys and Stripe-to-AKASHA notification delivery remain under verification; this note does not claim they passed.
verification: Production revision 77aef1a3 was Ready and assigned to both VOA domains. At 2026-09-25 05:38 UTC, 134/134 distinct sitemap URLs plus three extra route/data checks returned HTTP 200; the live Codex index reported 824 entries and 27 systems. A single guest Dreamwalker Remote Viewing browser response completed; this is not a controlled performance benchmark or a paid-member test.

label: Dreamwalker · API repair
title: Remote Viewing questions can reach the Dreamwalker again
summary: The Dreamwalker menu’s Remote Viewing prompts no longer hit an unsupported-mode error at the Oracle API.
details: The API now recognizes the dedicated Dreamwalker modes already defined in its prompts, including lucid dreaming, dream yoga, astral practice, and remote viewing.
The repair keeps each question in its intended mode instead of silently substituting a generic answer.
A representative Remote Viewing request completed with five source passages and a full answer. Broader logged-in browser journeys are still under review.
verification: Verified against the live Dreamwalker API with a single source-backed Remote Viewing request and a healthy service check on September 24; not a blanket guarantee for every question.

label: Release 0aaec29
title: A steadier Oracle release
summary: The September release tightened the path from question to saved reading, repaired Daily fallback behavior, corrected Library records, and added new Scroll material.
details: Daily now returns built-in practice entries when a serverless cache cannot be written; the release smoke check found four nonempty gateway keys.
Oracle and Journal state now carry the selected tradition, mode, conversation, and assistant replies through restore and continue paths.
Two Library source records were corrected, and the release includes the updated plan-based entitlement rules.
The Scroll gained Book of Thoth: Egyptian Knowledge as Scribe and The Imaginal World of Ibn Arabi, with identified video embeds and cross-links added in the released code.
Account and billing error paths were hardened, including retryable account-service failures instead of a false guest snapshot.
Subscription-event alert plumbing shipped in the release. No external notification delivery is claimed here; end-to-end delivery remains under verification.
verification: Release commit 0aaec29 was deployed as the current release; the release test run passed 35/35 and the production build generated 195 static pages. Public-route and sitemap smoke checks passed. Authenticated member paths and client-side interactions were outside that smoke-check scope.

label: Reliability
title: The Agora initializes only when needed
summary: Forum routes now create their database client on request instead of initializing it during every module load.
details: This keeps public route loading independent from forum-only configuration until a forum action is requested.
The change reduces avoidable startup work for the rest of the site.
verification: Source commit b3c15dd changed both forum thread route handlers to lazy initialization.

label: Reliability
title: Billing webhook startup is lighter
summary: The billing webhook now initializes its Stripe client only when a webhook request needs it.
details: Public pages no longer need to construct the webhook client as part of unrelated module loading.
The change makes configuration boundaries clearer and keeps webhook concerns inside the webhook route.
verification: Source commit 3e0d592 changed the billing webhook route to lazy initialization.

label: Search visibility
title: Search titles stay within useful limits
summary: Page-title handling now trims long titles cleanly so search previews remain readable instead of ending mid-word.
details: The shared SEO helper now enforces a practical title length for pages that use it.
The contact page was brought onto the same bounded title behavior.
verification: Source commit 69db7b0 tightened the shared title helper and the contact-page metadata.

label: Search visibility
title: Search descriptions stay concise
summary: Shared description handling now bounds long metadata while preserving a complete final thought where possible.
details: Long descriptions are normalized before they are emitted into page metadata.
The helper adds an ellipsis only when content must be shortened.
verification: Source commit 0f83ee8 added the bounded description behavior to the shared SEO helper.
